title: Add two vectors
prompt: The robot moves by a step. Return a plus b. Adding vectors adds the x parts together and the y parts together: (1, 2) + (3, 4) is (4, 6).
starter:
func solve(a, b) -> Vector2:
	return a

tests.name: Adding to zero gives the other

hints: The + sign works on whole vectors.

docs.name: a + b, a - b, v * number, v / number
docs.what: Vectors add and subtract part by part, and scale by a plain number.

solution:
func solve(a, b) -> Vector2:
	return a + b
